messages.subject: secr 5.3.0
parts: secr 5.3.0 is now on CRAN.  There is new functionality for modelling spatial variation in detection parameters lambda0 and sigma (see secr-detectionxy.pdf) and for relative density models. Simulation of Ornstein-Uhlenbeck movement and detection with functions simOU() and simOU.capthist() has been moved from package secrdesign.
